articles.title: Malaysia foreign minister calls for review of UN refugee agency's presence: Reports
articles.summary: Mohamad Hasan's comments came a day after authorities detained more than 100 Rohingya asylum seekers who had gathered outside the agency's premises in Kuala Lumpur to seek assistance after being evicted from their homes in Penang state.
